ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 6:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white field across the central area. Continuous low-intensity black band along the trailing edge topography. Vertical dark-grey pigmentation streak originating at the median notch. Discrete dark pixel clusters (mottling) distributed across the mid-to-distal regions of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth of approximately 65 pixels from the adjacent trailing edge peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge with serration amplitudes between 4-10 pixels; higher frequency of peaks observed on the left lobe relative to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading (outer) edges exhibit a continuous convex curve from the center to the distal tips; trailing edge displays a sigmoid (S-shaped) curve, convex near the notch and concave near the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 12 discrete, roughly circular low-intensity clusters (5-12 pixel diameter) localized on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel disruptions: three distinct diagonal streaks on the right lobe and two finer horizontal streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical dark pigmentation anomaly/scar extending from the median notch into the fluke surface; a significant jagged indentation is visible on the far-right distal trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: A fine, curvilinear dark mark forming a semi-loop is present on the upper-left quadrant of the white fluke surface.
